component.name: Folio
component.summary: Offline vector handwriting and notes for Linux

description.p: Write pressure-sensitive notes with a stylus, organize notebooks, annotate PDFs and search titles, tags and typed text. Your original ink stays editable and private.
No account or cloud service is required.
Compact writing tools, simpler pen settings and user presets, accurate color selection, theme-aware default ink, folder menus and drag-and-drop, refined tabs and corrected cached update offers.
